            "risk_reduction": [
                "Enable multi‑factor authentication (MFA) for all user accounts",
                "Deploy email filtering to flag or quarantine suspicious senders",
                "Run regular security awareness training and phishing simulations"
            ]
        },
        {
            "area": "Enterprise",
            "nature": "insider_data_exfiltration",
            "description": "A trusted employee copies sensitive customer data onto a personal USB drive and transfers it out of the corporate network.",

                "Implement strict USB/device usage policies with endpoint DLP",
                "Monitor file access and data transfer logs for anomalies",
                "Enforce least‑privilege access controls"
            ]
        },
        {
            "area": "Enterprise",
            "nature": "privilege_escalation",
            "description": "An attacker exploits a misconfigured service to gain administrative privileges on a critical server, allowing them to install backdoors and move laterally.",

                "Regularly audit and patch operating systems and services",
                "Use role‑based access control and avoid running processes as root",
                "Deploy intrusion detection systems (IDS) to catch unusual privilege use"
            ]

        {
            "area": "Cloud",
            "nature": "misconfigured_storage",
            "description": "An S3 bucket containing customer PII is left publicly readable, exposing sensitive data to the internet.",

                "Enforce automated checks for public‑access settings",
                "Use IAM policies to restrict bucket access to known roles",
                "Enable bucket logging and review access logs regularly"
            ]
        },

                "Mask or redact PII in non‑production environments",

            ]

            "description": "An outdated educational software package with known vulnerabilities is still in use on campus machines, opening attackers to remote code execution risks.",
